plugin.name: Study Copilot Catgirl
plugin.description: Sync your own learning-platform progress, search free open course resources, build study plans, generate staged practice questions that follow real exam patterns, diagnose weak points and give score forecasts plus personal counseling.
plugin.short_description: A study copilot that plans, quizzes, grades your papers and keeps you going.
entries.study_plan.name: Build study plan
entries.study_plan.description: Generate long-term and short-term plans from target exam, goal score, days left and daily minutes.
entries.study_diagnose.name: Diagnose learning
entries.study_diagnose.description: Infer weak knowledge points from questions, papers, region and school, then report them.
entries.study_vision.name: Read screenshot
entries.study_vision.description: Read the most recent screenshot of a question or exam paper, transcribe it, then diagnose weak points and explain.
entries.study_teach.name: Teach a topic
entries.study_teach.description: Explain a knowledge point with staged worked examples, filling prerequisites first if needed.
entries.study_quiz.name: Generate quiz
entries.study_quiz.description: Produce basic, medium-with-traps or advanced questions following the topic's exam patterns.
entries.study_forecast.name: Forecast score
entries.study_forecast.description: Give conservative, most-likely and ideal score expectations with reasoning.
entries.study_comfort.name: Counsel the learner
entries.study_comfort.description: Personalized encouragement based on exam type, days left and emotional state.
entries.study_search.name: Search resources
entries.study_search.description: Search free open courses and question banks for material matching the current topic.
entries.study_platform_sync.name: Sync platforms
entries.study_platform_sync.description: Sync courses, progress and assignments from your own platform accounts (read-only).
entries.study_profile.name: Learner profile
entries.study_profile.description: View or edit exam target, region, subjects, goal score and available time.
entries.study_status.name: Copilot status
entries.study_status.description: Return an overview of profile, platform links, resource search and plan progress.
ui.panel.title: Study Copilot Catgirl
ui.panel.subtitle: Profile · Plan · Platforms · Resources · Diagnosis
reply.no_profile: No exam target yet, meow. Tell me what you are preparing for, where, and roughly when.
reply.plan_saved: The plan is built and saved, meow. Ask me anytime to adjust it.
reply.synced: Platform progress has been synced locally, meow.
reply.quiz_intro: These questions follow real exam patterns, meow. Send me your answers when done.
reply.vision_intro: I have read the screenshot, meow. Here is the transcription and diagnosis.
reply.vision_need_image: I have not received your screenshot yet, meow. Just send the question or paper screenshot in chat and say "read this" - no typing needed.
reply.forecast_intro: Here are three score scenarios, meow. See the gap before choosing where to push.
reply.comfort_intro: Take a breath first, meow. One step at a time.
